guardEvidence.howCaught: Six registry models drive the real local-verify decision functions under the pinned sustained-pressure fixture: one automatic error re-run per (pr, head); capacity requeues never count as attempts and the starved signal fires once; main verifies at most one per debounce window and at most 1+3 per head; status posts at most one batch per 60s pass with the 30/min cap (withdrawals bounded by heads holding success); PR-list failures back off at least 2 min.
